# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

GVault has not had a public Chrome Web Store launch yet. Security updates apply only to the current development line.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.2.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.2   | :x:                |

The `.gvault.json` format in this line is **version 2** only. Version 1 vault files are not supported.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for a security vulnerability.

Email **[meganbailey@sandiego.edu](mailto:meganbailey@sandiego.edu)** with:

- A description of the issue and its impact
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept if you have one
- Affected version or commit, if you know it

You should receive an acknowledgement within **3 business days**, and a status update at least every **7 days** until the report is closed.

If the report is accepted, we will work on a fix, credit you if you want that, and describe the issue in release notes after a patch is available. If it is declined, we will explain why (for example, it is not a vulnerability, or it is already known).
